surface: The complete documented destroy option set and the root command's persistent options, with reviewed Boolean controls, bounded integer flags, output and color enums, nonempty override assignments and stack/target/exclude/message/config/config-file values. Exact request shape remains separate from May effects and unresolved stack identity. Raw mutually exclusive flags reject even false-valued occurrences. Target/exclude/protected selection narrows whole-stack scope; refresh and suppress-permalink Boolean options use their no-value default without consuming a following token. Remove deletes the stack configuration file the run discovers. Remote deployment options are recognized; a remote run hands the operation to a Pulumi Cloud executor, so it keeps the process delegation and a remote_command boundary for the git source, executor image and pre-run commands rather than certifying this host's reviewed effects. A url operand stays unrecognized because remote support is environment-determined.
